notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Othelm, untapping Othelm.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning the nontoken creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
